answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. New agents enter an economic grove by staking collateral that scales superlinearly with cluster density: each replica in a Sybil swarm faces exponential capital exhaustion, turning the attacker's treasury into a dry lagoon. When a sudden gale of rogue identities strikes, polynomial bond burns ensure fraud remains economically prohibitive.
